trap.label: associate with
trap.wrong: Analysts associate the rise of prices.
trap.right: Analysts associate the rise with prices.
trap.why: Em português “associar a” → to. Em inglês, associate A with B.

mcq.q: The more data, the ___ the model.

fix.right: It is known to cause delay.
The more data, the better the model.

rewrite.prompt: Use associate with: “Analysts link wealth to health.”
Use known to: “People know that it causes delay.” (It…)
rewrite.answer: It is known to cause delay.

rewrite.prompt: Use the…the: “With more data the model is better.”
rewrite.answer: The more data, the better the model.
